generated.$comment: A-010: the observation form with NO tooling-coupling classification. Every entry omits `generated`, because this producer implements no deterministic classifier and declines to assert one. Absence is the third state — it means unclassified, not false. The lockfile/manifest pair is deliberately present and deliberately unflagged: a reader that collapses absent into false would read it as a confirmed real source coupling, which is precisely the unsupported certainty the amendment removed. Note also that this document is NOT mixed-form: the legacy/observation discriminator is `rate` vs `support`, and the classification flag plays no part in it.
